canvasDomains.title: Additional Canvas domains
canvasDomains.description: Vanity Canvas hostnames (for example canvas.school.edu) the toolkit should run on, in addition to *.instructure.com.

features.title: Feature switches
features.description: Force individual modules on (true) or off (false). Omitted modules follow the user's own setting.

backendUrl.title: Toolkit backend URL
backendUrl.description: Reserved for shared snippet libraries and licence checks (phase 4).

snippetLibrary.title: Default snippet library
snippetLibrary.description: Snippets pushed to every instructor, shown read-only beside their own.
